headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned Hamas that if any Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza would be evacuated. Addressing the memorial ceremony for the Yom Kippur War fallen, Gallant asserted that Israel would not back down from its red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the strip is demilitarized. He also spoke about the campaign against Iran, claiming they eliminated Khamenei and removed the threat of nuclear annihilation. Gallant emphasized that the mission is not over and they will strike a third time if necessary.

headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron, who was murdered in an attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest. Family, friends, and residents accompanied him at the cemetery. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, bid farewell, expressing gratitude for his father giving him life. His wife described Natanel as the most involved father, and his sister remembered him as a pleasant, wise, and humble person.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron is the individual killed in the attack near the Ein Bubin spring in Benjamin. The attacker opened fire on people at the spring, abandoned his vehicle, and fled on foot. Natanel Shkaron, a father of six from Alfei Menashe, who had come to immerse himself before Yom Kippur, was evacuated in critical condition to Beilinson Hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Following an extensive manhunt, Duvdevan unit soldiers apprehended the attacker inside a hospital in Ramallah. About an hour later, a second attacker attempting a ramming attack in the northern Samaria region was neutralized.
